commit.subject: crypto/sha3: add internal ReadMulti for batched SHAKE squeezing
commit.message:
crypto/sha3: add internal ReadMulti for batched SHAKE squeezing

ReadMulti reads from multiple SHAKE states at once, with exactly the
same results as sequential Read calls, computing the Keccak permutations
of lockstep states together where a multi-lane kernel is available.

The actual kernels are in following CLs.

This will be used in the ML-KEM and ML-DSA implementations.

Change-Id: Ia08bc8260a0b1c93292f81d822fd29a16a6a6964

commit.subject: crypto/sha3: add two-lane Keccak-f[1600] for arm64 SHA3 extensions
commit.message:
crypto/sha3: add two-lane Keccak-f[1600] for arm64 SHA3 extensions

The existing keccakF1600NEON kernel computes on full 128-bit vectors but
only occupies the low 64-bit halves: the round constant is already
broadcast to both halves by VLD1R, and the upper halves compute a
discarded second permutation. Load the second state into the high
halves, permuting two states for nearly the price of one.

Unlike the single-lane kernel, which stays Darwin-only, the two-lane
kernel is enabled wherever the SHA-3 instructions are available: on
cores with a single SHA3-capable SIMD unit it roughly matches two scalar
permutations, and on cores that implement the instructions on all SIMD
units (Apple M series, Cortex-A510, Cortex-X4 and later) it is about
twice as fast.

ReadMulti now batches lockstep states in pairs on arm64.

Change-Id: I04dfa57c8fc38318f61e7f2b16f509866a6a6964

commit.subject: crypto/sha3: add four-lane AVX2 Keccak-f[1600] for amd64
commit.message:
crypto/sha3: add four-lane AVX2 Keccak-f[1600] for amd64

keccakF1600x4AVX2 applies the permutation to four states at once, one
64-bit Keccak lane from each state per 256-bit register. The states are
interleaved in-register into two ping-pong stack buffers, with the θ D
values and the current fused ρ+π+χ row held in registers, VPSHUFB for
the ρ rotations by 8 and 56, and VPANDN for χ. The kernel is generated
by a new avo program alongside the existing scalar one.

Change-Id: I30990102535eb7bcf9acec01e1157b556a6a6964
